name: Senior Golden Bear Pass
description: California State Parks offers a $20 Senior Golden Bear Pass for people age 62 and over, giving free vehicle day-use entry to over 200 state park units outside the peak summer season.
fullDescription: California State Parks offers a $20 Senior Golden Bear Pass for people age 62 and over, giving free vehicle day-use entry to over 200 state park units outside the peak summer season.
whatTheyOffer:
- $20 pass for people 62+ that also covers a spouse or registered domestic partner
- Free vehicle day-use entry at over 200 parks operated by California State Parks
- Not valid during peak season (the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day at most parks)
- Valid from the date issued until December 31 of that year
howToGetIt: Apply in person at a designated State Parks pass sales location (fastest), online through ReserveCalifornia, or by mail with the application form. You'll need proof of age (62 or older) and the $20 payment. After approval you get a 30-day temporary pass to use while your card is mailed.
keywords: Senior Golden Bear Pass, state parks, 62+, $20 annual pass, seniors, California parks, discount pass
